title: How Majestic Is Your Name

questions.question: O Lord, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 8:1 (ESV): "O Lord, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!"

questions.question: When I look at your heavens, the work of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 8:3 (ESV): "When I look at your heavens, the work of your fingers..."

questions.question: What is man that you are mindful of him, and the son of man that you do what for him?
questions.explanation: Psalm 8:4 (ESV): "...and the son of man that you care for him?"

questions.question: You have made him a little lower than the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 8:5 (ESV): "Yet you have made him a little lower than the heavenly beings..." (Hebrew: Elohim)

questions.question: You have given him dominion over the works of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 8:6 (ESV): "You have given him dominion over the works of your hands;"

questions.question: Out of the mouth of babies and infants, you have established what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 8:2 (ESV): "Out of the mouth of babies and infants, you have established strength..."

questions.question: To still the enemy and the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 8:2 (ESV): "...to still the enemy and the avenger."

questions.question: You have put all things under his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 8:6 (ESV): "...you have put all things under his feet,"

questions.question: The birds of the heavens, and the fish of the sea, whatever passes along the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 8:8 (ESV): "...whatever passes along the paths of the seas."

questions.question: What animals are mentioned as being under man's feet?
options: All sheep and oxen, and also the beasts of the field
questions.correctAnswer: All sheep and oxen, and also the beasts of the field
questions.explanation: Psalm 8:7 (ESV): "all sheep and oxen, and also the beasts of the field,"

questions.question: You have crowned him with what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 8:5 (ESV): "...and crowned him with glory and honor."

questions.question: The moon and the stars, which you have set in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 8:3 (ESV): "...the moon and the stars, which you have set in place,"

questions.question: You have set your glory above the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 8:1 (ESV): "...You have set your glory above the heavens."

questions.question: What is the title of Psalm 8?
questions.explanation: Common title derived from verse 1. In ESV it is often titled "How Majestic Is Your Name".

questions.question: The Psalmist addresses the Psalm to the Choirmaster according to what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 8 Title: "To the choirmaster: according to The Gittith. A Psalm of David."

key_verse_text: O Lord, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!
